net.offline: You're offline: the app is using what it already carries.
map.label: Map of spots
map.hereGrouped: {n} spots here, {g} in the balls of yarn
map.noPosition: I can't read your position. Check the permission.
spots.search: Search a spot or a city
spots.subtitle: {n} verified by the family
spot.communityNote: Reported by the community and not yet verified by a person: look before you leap.
spot.missing: This spot is not among the ones the app carries.
spot.noPositionYet: I don't know where you are. Your position stays on the phone: it is only used for the distance.
spot.straight: {distanza} as the crow flies · {cammino} walking · {corsa} running
spot.straightNote: Straight line: the real way is longer.
spot.routePrivacy: The start was rounded to ~{metri} m before leaving the phone.
spot.routeFailed: The route needs the network, and there is none right now.
spot.noteNote: The note stays on this device. Nobody else reads it.
spot.notePlaceholder: How it was, what you tried, when to come back…
spot.fountainsSource: From OpenStreetMap, stored in here: visible without network too.
spot.fixNote: It stays on the device until you send it: the app publishes nothing on its own.
spot.fixPlaceholder: The place is fenced, the name is wrong, the coordinates are off…
spot.fixQueued: Saved in the queue. You'll find it in the You screen.
tutorials.subtitle: {n} videos in the catalogue
tutorials.needNet: The video lives online: you need the network to watch it.
legal.title: Before you train
legal.summary.spot: It holds for every spot you find in this app.
legal.summary.tutorial: It holds for every tutorial you open from here.
legal.point.risk: Parkour carries a real and unavoidable risk of injury, including serious injury.
legal.point.liability: Responsibility for an injury at a spot listed here, or while following a tutorial published here, is yours alone.
legal.point.places: Spots are third-party places: we don't run them, we don't check them and we don't guarantee they are safe.
legal.point.role: The platform only undertakes to make the information available, free and easy to reach.
legal.accept: Understood, I go at my own risk
you.installWhy: Installed, PkFAMILY has its own icon, opens full screen and starts in flight mode too.
you.installDone: Already installed: you're using it as an app.
you.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
you.installOther: From the browser menu pick “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
you.offlineNoSw: Here the app cannot work offline: it needs a secure address (https, or localhost when testing from a computer).
you.offlineFiles: {n} app files already on the device
you.prepareWhy: Download the map of the area you see now: when you get there, with no signal, it will still be here.
you.prepareAsk: {n} tiles, about {peso}. They download now, on the network you have.
you.prepareDone: Done: {scaricate} new, {saltate} already there, {fallite} didn't arrive.
you.clearTilesAsk: Deletes stored tiles and photos. The app keeps working offline; the map goes back to linen where there is no network.
you.dataStaysHere: Saved spots, notes and position stay on this device.
you.queueNote: You wrote them and they haven't left: they will when the app is connected to the backend.
you.queueClearAsk: What you wrote will be lost.
you.resetAsk: Deletes saved spots, notes, queue and preferences from this device.
you.accountLocal: This copy of the app is not connected to any account: it works on its own, with the data it carries.
you.accountConfigured: The app can connect to the backend when there is network.
you.aboutSpots: {n} spots in the app, {v} verified by the family.
you.aboutOnlyVerified: Only verified spots are public on the product map: the others stay marked community until a person checks them.
you.credits: Maps © OpenStreetMap contributors · Satellite Esri · Water points from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) · Fraunces and Karla typefaces (OFL).
you.betaWhat: This is a test copy: it exists to find the faults before anyone else does.
you.betaProblemNote: It stays on this device, queued, together with where you were and your screen size. You copy it out when you want.
you.betaProblemPlaceholder: What you were doing, what you expected, what happened…
you.devWhat: Developer mode opens a panel to correct spots and settings. Changes stay on this device until you export them.
you.devAsk: From here on you can change spots, sources and links. Nothing is published: you export files, and a person carries them into the product.
admin.title: Developer mode
admin.subtitle: local changes, not published
admin.rule1: 1. Everything you change stays on this device: you export it, you don't publish it.
admin.rule2: 2. Nothing pretends to be verified: what you touch is marked “local”.
admin.rule3: 3. No secret key in here: only the publishable one.
admin.deleteAsk: “{nome}” disappears from the map and the list on this device.
admin.tookCentre: Coordinates taken from the map centre.
admin.secretRefused: That looks like a secret key: it doesn't go here. The publishable one does.
admin.filesNote: The export is a file to review and carry into the repository by hand: the app writes nowhere.
admin.resetAsk: Corrected, added and removed spots and changed settings go back to the file.
admin.aiuto.filtroTessere.chiaro: CSS filter applied to the tiles in the light theme.
admin.aiuto.filtroTessere.scuro: CSS filter in the dark theme: here it takes an inversion, not less light.
admin.aiuto.tiles.mappa.url: Address with {z}/{x}/{y}. Changing it changes the map, not the satellite.
admin.aiuto.routing.decimali: Digits the position leaves the phone with: 3 = about 110 m.
admin.aiuto.supabase.publishableKey: Publishable key only. The secret key never goes in a client.
